mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT a.FILE_ID from meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_pr_requirement_head h JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_supplier_cooperate.scc_npm_pr_require_attach a on a.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID = h.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_ID
where h.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_NUM IN #{item}

SELECT DISTINCT s.FILEUPLOAD_ID from meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_bid_data_submit ds JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_base.scc_base_scene_file s on s.BUSINESS_ID = ds.data_submit_id and s.SCENE_MODULE_CODE='SCENE_BID_DATA_SUBMIT_ATTACHMENT' where ds.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_NUM IN #{item} and ds.`STATUS` ='APPROVED'

SELECT DISTINCT s.FILEUPLOAD_ID from meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_answer a JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_base.scc_base_scene_file s on s.SCENE_MODULE_CODE IN ('SCENE_SOU_QUESTION_FILE_ATTACHMENT' , 'SCENE_SOU_ANSWER_INNER_FILE_ATTACHMENT','SCENE_SOU_ANSWER_REPLAY_FILE_ATTACHMENT') and s.BUSINESS_ID = a.ANSWER_ID where a.PROJECT_ID =#{projectId}

SELECT DISTINCT s.FILEUPLOAD_ID from meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_ca c join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_base.scc_base_scene_file s on s.BUSINESS_ID = c.ca_id and s.SCENE_MODULE_CODE='SCENE_SOU_CA_ATTACHMENT' where c.type = 'APPLY' and c.`status` = 'APPROVED' and c.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT i.attachment_id fileId from meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_bid_notice_internal i join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_bid_notice n on n.bid_notice_id = i.bid_notice_id and n.type = 'APPLY' and n.`status` ='APPROVED' and n.project_id = #{projectId}
UNION ALL SELECT i.notice_attachment_id fileId from meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_bid_notice_detail i join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_bid_notice n on n.bid_notice_id = i.bid_notice_id and n.type = 'APPLY' and n.`status` ='APPROVED' and n.project_id = #{projectId}

select DISTINCT f.SOU_DOC_ID from meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_project p join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_demand d on d.PROJECT_ID = p.PROJECT_ID join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_file f on f.PROJECT_ID = p.PROJECT_ID where p.SOU_TYPE='recomm' and p.PROJECT_STATUS='APPROVED' and p.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT DISTINCT s.FILEUPLOAD_ID from meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_pre_bid_notice p join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_base.scc_base_scene_file s on s.SCENE_MODULE_CODE = 'PRE_BID_COMM_EDIT_ATTACHMENT' and s.BUSINESS_ID = p.BID_NOTICE_ID where p.REQUIREMENT_HEAD_NO IN #{item}
SELECT p.EXT_PROJECT_NO from meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_project p where p.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}
